purpose: Select prospective experimental shadow cells; not paper promotion or a profitability guarantee

selection.universe: 20 crypto perpetuals selected by present turnover >= $1M, spread <=10bps and complete $750 buy/sell depth; no P&L selection of universe
selection.fundingSensitivity: additional adverse 0.01% notional per started 8h holding interval, for sensitivity only; not actual historical settlements or a worst-case bound
selection.deployment: up to six additional experimental shadow cells; no paper enablement, promotion or changed risk/evidence rules
selection.confirmation: selected finalists must survive minute-path replay and runtime-history signal parity; forward shadow remains the qualification judge

historyExtension.reason: Most 1h and 4h cells have too few closed trades in 60 days; extend all 20 markets equally, without changing scanner parameters or sample thresholds.
historyExtension.qualification: Retrospective research only; later period has already been partially inspected. Forward shadow is required before any paper admission.

last 60 days; research confirmation only, not untouched forward qualification

limitations: Current liquid-universe selection entails survivorship bias; market rankings are not historical.
Historical funding settlements and historical depth are unavailable; additional funding is a sensitivity, not measured cash cost or a worst-case bound.
Full-history screens are retrospective. The 180-day later period partly overlaps the earlier screen, so this is not untouched out-of-sample proof.
Minute OHLC cannot resolve intra-minute path, queue priority or tick-exact fills. Forward research uses causal execution and durable tape/depth.

Each finalist has one open trade at the data cutoff; it is not counted as a win. Subtracting a $30 stop-budget reserve from each later paired-stress total remains positive, but this is not a bound on gaps or future funding.
A trade entered before a split and closed after it is not counted in the later-entry cohort; no lookahead retraining or threshold tuning.
Only entry bars of closed replay trades were checked against rolling 1,000-bar history; 105/105 match. This is not exhaustive parity for every no-signal bar.
Experiments remain excluded from promotion/copying/sizing. New paper admission needs the normal prospective evidence process.
